claims.source_quote:
def _export_pdf(self,
                    report: GovernanceReport,
                    results: List[RuleExecutionResult],
                    custom_file_name: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """复用原生 DOCX 报告，再由 LibreOffice 保留分页和表格布局转为 PDF。"""
        if not self._check_soffice_available():
            raise RuntimeError("PDF 导出需要 LibreOffice Writer，请安装 libreoffice-writer。")
        file_name = self._make_filename(report, 'pdf', custom_file_name=custom_file_name)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='onticards_pdf_') as tmp_dir:
            source_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, 'report.docx')
            _build_docx_with_python(report, results, source_path)
            converted = self._convert_via_local_soffice(source_path, 'pdf', file_name)
            if converted:
                return converted
        raise RuntimeError("PDF 导出失败：LibreOffice 未生成 PDF 文件。")

local_soffice_path = _get_local_soffice_path()
        if local_soffice_path:
            print(f"[LibreOffice-Exporter] [Tier 1] 本地 soffice 可用 ({local_soffice_path})，开始转换 {target_fmt}...")
            try:

                    print(f"[LibreOffice-Exporter] [Tier 1] ✅ soffice 转换成功 | mode={result['mode']}")
                    self._cleanup_tmp_dir(tmp_dir)
                    return result
            except Exception as e:
                last_err = e
                print(f"[LibreOffice-Exporter] [Tier 1] ❌ soffice 转换失败，降级: {e}")
        else:
            print(f"[LibreOffice-Exporter] [Tier 1] soffice 未找到，跳过")

        # ===== Tier 2: 纯 Python 降级 =====
        print(f"[LibreOffice-Exporter] [Tier 2] 进入纯 Python 降级方案...")

                'file_path': file_path,
                'file_name': file_name,
                'file_size': os.path.getsize(file_path),
                'format': 'docx',
                'mode': 'python-docx',
            }
        elif target_fmt == 'pdf':
            # soffice Tier 1 已在上面失败，不再有降级方案
            # 直接抛出错误（PDF 格式暂时不支持）
